intro: Gameweek 5, gentlemen, and Brighton ran riot with a 3-0 win over Arsenal while Brentford saw off Chelsea by the same score. Man City 5-3 Sunderland was absolute scenes, and Spurs 2-3 Aston Villa was a proper Sunday League defensive effort. Brahmes topped the week with 55, just ahead of Ben on 54, while Louie propped up the table with a 30. Asher is still in front on 266, Ben is lurking on 259 and the title race is ON. Jack nipped up to fifth and Louie slid down to sixth. Josh and Jonny held their places in third and fourth, and Brahmes, with that 55, stays seventh.
motw: Brahmes, 55 points, and the only man in the league to go over 50 without Ben's help. Cunha scored, Barnes got two assists, and Virgil kept a clean sheet. Nothing flashy, just a lot of players doing their job. Never in doubt, apart from the fact he's still seventh.
stinker: Louie, 30 points, bottom of the pile and down a place. Haaland scored for six, which is a quiet day for him, and four defenders came back with four each at best. Seven on the bench for Mitchell, who sat there on a clean sheet. The bench is where points go to die.
bench: Ben left 20 points on the bench, which is a lot of lads watching from the sidelines. Kostoulas scored and assisted for 10, and Vuskovic kept a clean sheet for 8 while sat in the dugout. He still scored 54, so he can afford it. Somebody tell him the bench isn't a trophy cabinet.
red_card: Jonny owned Cash, who played 45 minutes for Villa, picked up a yellow, conceded two and came away with minus one. That's a hospital ball of a fixture for a defender. The Villa lads are buzzing, Jonny less so.
gloves: Louie again, this time with Raya, who conceded three at Brighton and scored one point. Two saves wasn't going to save anyone. Arsenal got rinsed and so did the owner.

xi.385: Trafford kept a clean sheet for Leeds with five saves and three bonus for 10. Josh had him on the bench, which is a bold way to run a team.
xi.229: Tarkowski got an assist, a clean sheet and three bonus for 14. Jack's defender, Jack's gain. Set and forget.
xi.449: Hall scored and picked up three bonus for 13. A defender on the scoresheet is a differential Jamie will happily take.
xi.504: Vuskovic kept a clean sheet for Brighton and made 12 defensive contributions for 8. Ben's reward was a seat on the bench.
xi.397: Semenyo scored twice and assisted once for 17, even with three conceded. Asher's captain material, and he played himself into form.
xi.124: Groß got a goal, an assist and three bonus for 14. Ben had a good day, and Brighton were having a party.
xi.428: Cunha scored in a 1-1 draw with three bonus for 10. Brahmes will take that all day.
xi.94: Schade made two assists and kept a clean sheet for 9. Josh was well served by the Brentford win.
xi.453: Barnes made two assists for 9 at Newcastle. Brahmes is quietly collecting these.
xi.552: Brobbey hit a hat-trick for 17 despite Sunderland conceding five. A worldie of a day for Ben, who has plenty more where that came from.
xi.138: Kostoulas scored and assisted in 75 minutes for 10. Ben had him on the bench, so that was 10 points to wave from the touchline.
